# Instructions
*This is a template to help you make good pull requests. You may use [Github Markdown](https://help.github.com/articles/getting-started-with-writing-and-formatting-on-github/) syntax to format your issue report.*
*Please:*
- *only keep the "FIX", "CLOSE", "NEW", "UXUI", "PERF" or "QUAL" section* (use uppercase to have the PR appears into the ChangeLog, lowercase will not appears)
- *follow the project [contributing guidelines](/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)*
- ***in particular, in case of a bugfix, please check that you are targetting the branch corresponding to the oldest version in which the bug occurs***
- ***if your PR changes the User Interface (screens, forms, css, js, ...), paste at least one screenshot into the description (before and after if possible), otherwise the CI will refuse your PR***
- *replace the bracket enclosed texts with meaningful information*


# FIX|Fix|CLOSE|Close #[*issue_number Short description*]
[*Long description*]


# NEW|New|UXUI|Uxui|PERF|Perf|QUAL|Qual [*Short description*]
[*Long description*]
